name: Example Mod C#

localizedSummaries.en-US: The tModLoader ExampleMod in C#, ported as the C# loaders arrive. For now: the Example Item, the Sword, the recipes, the Example armor, wings and shield, the Example damage class with its weapon and stat bonus accessory.

summary: O ExampleMod do tModLoader em C#, portado conforme os loaders C# chegam. Por enquanto: o Exemplo de Item, a Espada, as receitas, a armadura, as asas e o escudo de exemplo.
